1.summary: Adds a full stop to one note string. The edit is tiny, but it sits in the payments ledger, which the team marks as a sensitive path.

sections.title: What changes
sections.text: `postCharge()` writes the note `charge posted.` where it wrote `charge posted`.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: The note text had no full stop.

sections.title: What it reaches
sections.text: Only `postCharge()`. Nothing else calls the changed line.

sections.title: What is tested
sections.text: The ledger test passes. It checks the amount, not the note text.
